library.name: Rail network
library.author: alice
library.description: A small city rail network: sixteen stations on four lines, with timetables, fares and an operations store. Parameterised queries, query groups, rules, tests, benchmarks, ETL, notebooks and per-person graph access, all over the same data.

etlJobs.name: Stations from a CSV
etlJobs.author: dana
etlJobs.description: Builds one station per row of stations.csv, with a map point. The rows are a VALUES table in the SQL.
etlJobs.sql:
SELECT
  slug,
  name,
  zone,
  step_free = 'yes' AS stepFree,
  opened,
  'POINT(' || long || ' ' || lat || ')' AS wkt
FROM {{csv:etl/stations.csv}}
WHERE slug IS NOT NULL
  AND name IS NOT NULL
  AND zone IS NOT NULL
  AND step_free IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY slug

etlJobs.name: Departures from two CSVs
etlJobs.author: dana
etlJobs.description: Joins departures.csv to stations.csv in DuckDB, so each departure carries its station's name. The rows are VALUES tables in the SQL.
etlJobs.sql:
SELECT
  d.station || '-' || d.line || '-' || d.day_type || '-' || replace(CAST(d.time AS VARCHAR), ':', '') AS departureId,
  d.station AS stationId,
  s.name AS stationName,
  d.line AS lineId,
  d.towards AS towardsId,
  d.day_type AS dayTypeId,
  CAST(d.time AS VARCHAR) AS time
FROM {{csv:etl/departures.csv}} AS d
JOIN {{csv:etl/stations.csv}} AS s ON s.slug = d.station
WHERE d.line IS NOT NULL
  AND d.towards IS NOT NULL
  AND d.day_type IS NOT NULL
  AND d.time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.day_type, d.time, d.station
